name: adaptive-rag
title: Answer questions, with fact-checking

comparison.purpose: Routes each question to the corpus or to web search, grades what comes back, rewrites the query when it is weak, and checks the final answer is grounded before returning it.

starters: What are the trade-offs of optimistic vs pessimistic locking?
Who won the 2026 Super Bowl and by how much?
How should I size a connection pool?
